issue.title: Misplaced tracebacks from some models created in the reader

summary.text: A test reproducing the misplaced traceback position for reader-expanded models like `a.b` fails before the fix and passes after it, no regressions were found, and the changed lines were covered, but the guard, behaviour-diff and break-my-fix stages were inconclusive because too few valid mutants were run to judge the tests.
